criteria.name: autonomyBenefit
criteria.rule: AUT-1: value = min(1, n/2) where n = number of V150 sections the item advances whose sectionsStatus.title matches /AUTONOM/i; a §45 scenario contract always advances §45 ('BATTERIE DE DÉMONSTRATION DE L'AUTONOMIE'); items with no section mapping ⇒ NOT_MEASURED

criteria.name: capabilityGain
criteria.rule: CAP-1: value = min(1, n/4) where n = number of NON-§45 V150 sections in the advances of the top10NextInternal item(s) that reference the work item (a §45 contract X via '§45-X'), counting only sections whose sectionsStatus.status ≠ VALIDATED; not referenced by any top10 item ⇒ NOT_MEASURED

criteria.name: blockerRepetitionReduction
criteria.rule: BLK-0: NOT_MEASURED for every non-capability-gap item — no canonical field links a work item to the blockers/repetitions its completion would remove (CP8.gaps and V150 blockers are not keyed to work items); topic keywords are not evidence of benefit. CP8 capability-gap items use BLK-2 (capabilityGapRules.benefit)

criteria.name: reliabilityQuality
criteria.rule: REL-0: NOT_MEASURED for every non-capability-gap item — no evidence field records an expected reliability/quality gain per work item. CP8 capability-gap items use REL-2 (capabilityGapRules.benefit)

criteria.name: speedEfficiency
criteria.rule: SPD-0: NOT_MEASURED for every item — no evidence field records an expected speed/efficiency gain per work item

criteria.name: reusability
criteria.rule: REU-0: NOT_MEASURED for every item — no evidence field records reuse of a work item's output by other items

criteria.name: strategicValue
criteria.rule: STR-1: value = (11 - rank)/10 for the best V150 summary.top10NextInternal rank that references the item; listed only in summary.alsoInternal (unranked, after the top 10) ⇒ 0.05; absent from both ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (absence is not evidence of low value)

criteria.name: costRiskComplexity
criteria.rule: CRC-1: contracts only: value = min(1, (|acceptance_criteria| + |write_set|)/10 + (0.3 if an owner-gated step is stated)); items without a WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (no declared scope to size)

criteria.name: dependencyAvailability
criteria.rule: DEP-1: only when the evidence STATES a dependency: value = satisfied/stated (an owner-authorization dependency is unsatisfied while contract.authorizedBy is null; an 'IN_PROGRESS elsewhere' dependency is satisfied only if a field states it landed); no stated dependency ⇒ deps [] and NOT_MEASURED. CP8 capability-gap items use DEP-2 (capabilityGapRules.benefit)

criteria.name: evidenceLevel
criteria.rule: EVD-1: value = min(1, k/4) where k = |initialState.evidence| (contracts) + 1 if an executed scenario evidence file references the item + 1 if CP8 grades it + 1 if CP8.v150Matrix.note lists it executed; items with no pointer ⇒ k = 0 (a count, measured); CP8 capability-gap items: k = 1 per CP8 pointer (odgCapabilityAudit entry, gaps entry) + 1 per merged later evidence file whose gapRef cites the item (LAND-1)

capabilityGapRules.dedupe: DEDUP-1: provider-authored pairing table GAP_LINKS — a CP8.gaps entry matching a link's gapRe is the same gap as that link's odgCapabilityAudit entry (one item, both cited); a CP8.gaps entry matching no link becomes its own item (status PROPOSED, CP8 lists it open without an audit status)
capabilityGapRules.owner: OWN-2 (capability-gap items only; prior items keep OWN-1): requiresOwnerAuthorization iff the item's cited CP8 text matches /cryptograph|provider launch|launch a provider|billed|spend|auto-commit|commit/merge|human/coordinator-gated| host |systemd|sudo|deploy/i (negation guard as OWN-1), OR OWN-1 matches, OR a CP8.ownerQuestions entry is linked (open owner question). No authorization is created or inferred.
capabilityGapRules.landed: LAND-1: later evidence is reflected ONLY when a merged evidence file (V164+ other than this register's own output) carries a top-level gapRef naming 'odgCapabilityAudit.<key>' of the item; it is cited (landedEvidence) and counted in EVD-1, but the CP8 status is kept unless that file states a new status field for the gap (none does)

benefit.blocker: BLK-2 (CP8 capability-gap items only): n = number of distinct committed BLOCKER RECORDS (the declared blockerFields — CP8-or-later evidence only, so blockers removed by the PRs CP8 lists are not counted; a record repeated in a later checkpoint counts again: repetition) attributed to the gap, counting AT MOST ONE per source file (several fields of one file restate one observation; every matched record is still cited); a record is attributed iff it names the gap's audit number in an 'audit #a/#b' reference, OR its normalized text (lower-case; runs of '_', '-', whitespace ⇒ one space) contains one of the gap's declared blockerAnchors, an anchor being USABLE only if it occurs (normalized) in the gap's own cited CP8 text; value = min(1, n/4) — the divisor 4 is PROVIDER-AUTHORED (no canonical source scales it): it is the number of distinct files in blockerFields, so a gap blocking in every declared file reaches 1, and it matches the n/4 scale of CAP-1/EVD-1; n = 0 ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (absence from the declared record set is not evidence of no benefit)
benefit.reliability: REL-2 (CP8 capability-gap items only): r = number of independent-inspection REJECTs recorded in a CP8-or-later PR record (the declared prRecordFields) whose PR number the gap's own cited CP8 text cites as '#<n>' (the gap names that PR as its area's work); a record contributes the integer written immediately before 'REJECT' (optionally with one severity word, e.g. '2 HIGH REJECTs'); a REJECT mention without a count is UNCOUNTED (not guessed); value = min(1, r/4) — the divisor 4 is PROVIDER-AUTHORED (no canonical source scales it), chosen only to keep the n/4 scale of CAP-1/EVD-1/BLK-2; gap text cites no PR, or no counted REJECT ⇒ NOT_MEASURED
benefit.dependency: DEP-2 (CP8 capability-gap items only): a gap linked to a CP8.ownerQuestions entry (GAP_LINKS.oqRe) has that owner decision as its STATED dependency; it is UNSATISFIED (value 0/1) iff the latest checkpoint's ownerQuestions (latestCheckpoint) still lists a question matching the same oqRe; not re-listed ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (no field states it was resolved); no linked owner question ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (DEP-1)
notDerived: autonomyBenefit (AUT-1), capabilityGain (CAP-1), strategicValue (STR-1): no V150 section / top10 / alsoInternal entry references a CP8 capability gap
speedEfficiency (SPD-0), reusability (REU-0): no committed field records a speed or reuse effect per gap
costRiskComplexity (CRC-1): no WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT sizes a gap; the owner flag alone would give a size term of 0 by default, which is a default fill ⇒ NOT_MEASURED

continuityRules.closure: CLOSE-1: a WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT item whose contract carries an owner authorization block is CLOSED iff odg-authorization-scope.deriveAuthorizationScope(contract, committed {inspection, experiment, validation} records) is applicable, validates EVERY step of its declared sequence and has no current step; status = CLOSED_<grade> with <grade> = the VALIDATE_CRITERIA evidence scenarioGrade (the committed V*_<X>_CRITERIA_VALIDATION.json, R5b — bounded by the experiment outcome, never upgraded); any missing/invalid step ⇒ not closed (status from the earlier rules, closure.closed=false with the scope's reason). The pre-closure status is kept in statusHistory; criteria are kept (record preserved); CLOSED_* are non-selectable
continuityRules.resolution: RES-1: an item is RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE iff a committed evidence file carries top-level resolvesRegisterItem = the item id, resolution.status = 'FIXED', fixedBy.pr (integer), fixedBy.mergeCommit (40 hex) and ≥1 reproTests entry, AND (V16.9 Phase 1b, #949 LOW) an independent inspection reference (inspection.verdict ACCEPT, 40-hex inspection.inspectedHeadSha, distinct opaque inspectorSessionId/authorSessionId) AND odg-observation-currency.assessEvidenceCurrency usableAsProof over the injected sources.proofProbes (merge commit + inspected head exist in local git and are ancestors of main; no probe ⇒ refused); the file is cited; the earlier status is kept in statusHistory; a refused record is reported on the item (resolutionRefused) with its reason

dependencyGraph.rule: DEPG-1 (provider-authored, V17.5): item→item dependency edges are derived ONLY from explicit committed evidence — DATASET_INPUT, CODE_IMPORT, STATED_TEXT (definitions in edgeKinds); every edge cites its source (path#field) and the producer-side pointer; self-edges are dropped; a path containing '<' (a placeholder such as runtime/core/<defect-module>.ts) is not a concrete file and never matches. Applied UNIFORMLY to every register item kind: only WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT items declare inputs (preRegistration.dataset), a write_set or missingForPass, so every other kind gets dependencyGraph NOT_MEASURED with the reason (no edge is invented for them). Lineage (contract.parent) and shared inputs that no item produces are NOT dependencies. deps[] = the targets of UNSATISFIED edges (what the selector's eligibility gate and R1_MORE_UNBLOCKING read: an item is 'unblocked' by Y only while its dependency on Y is unsatisfied); DATASET_INPUT and STATED_TEXT edges (satisfaction can fail: pin/commit check, completion status) are stated dependencies for DEP-1 (depsStated) together with the register's existing owner-authorization prerequisites; CODE_IMPORT edges are STRUCTURAL ONLY (satisfied by construction ⇒ counted in fanOut, never in DEP-1 or deps[]); a write_set entry naming a file that is not committed is recorded in staleWriteSets (a limit, contracts are not edited). NO DEPENDENCY STATED ≠ NO DEPENDENCY: an item without a prerequisite edge keeps dependencyAvailability NOT_MEASURED with the reason 'no dependency stated'; 'measured: no dependency' would require a committed field STATING independence for that item, and no such field exists (independenceStated = [] — never inferred from absence)

edgeKinds.DATASET_INPUT: item X's contract declares, in WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.preRegistration.dataset (any depth), a `file` that is a declared OUTPUT of item Y (a path in Y's WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.write_set, or Y's executed scenario evidence file); satisfied iff that file is committed AND, when the dataset entry pins a sha256, its sha256 equals the pin (the runner refuses otherwise)
edgeKinds.CODE_IMPORT: a committed file in item X's WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.write_set requires (relative require, canonical parser) a file that is in item Y's WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.write_set; satisfied iff the required file is committed
edgeKinds.STATED_TEXT: item X's initialState.missingForPass names 'scenario Y' (the register's existing statement rule); satisfied iff Y's register status states completion (ACCEPTED, CLOSED_PASS or RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE) — no other field states it landed

contention.rule: CONT-1 (provider-authored, V17.5): write-set CONTENTION between WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT items = odg-writeset-contention.computeLayerContention over one layer of all contract items (path equal or directory-ancestor); a write_set containing a placeholder entry ('<…>') cannot be proven isolated ⇒ UNKNOWN (fail-closed, conflicts with every item). Contention is NOT a dependency: it never enters deps[], depsStated or any criterion

boussole.rule: BREF-1 (provider-authored; applied uniformly to every register item): (1) v150RequirementIds — WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT: the V171 matrix row whose v150.section is '§45 scenario X' for X = the contract scenario when it is an A–P letter, else contract.parent.scenario when that is an A–P letter (stated lineage); V150_TOP10_ITEM: rows of each V150 summary.top10NextInternal[i].advances entry ('§45-X' ⇒ '§45 scenario X', '§N…' ⇒ '§N'); V150_ALSO_INTERNAL / V150_OWNER_GATED: rows of the '§N' citations of the item's own V150 summary text (a citation directly preceded by a document name, e.g. 'V15_CLOSURE_DOSSIER §8', is not a V15.0 section and is skipped); every other kind: no field links it ⇒ []. (2) V12.4 — each row's anchors.v12_4 segment '<S> <MISSION-ID>' counts only if the canonical V12.4 companion lists MISSION-ID with section S; a section-only segment '<S> …' counts as section S only if the companion has a mission in S; 'none' / 'transversal' state no mission; v124MissionId = the single distinct mission over all rows, else null (ambiguous or none); v124Section = that mission's section, else the single distinct section, else null.
